title: Pullback of the constant-sheaf global-unit power map
statement: Let $g:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-over-base], and let $n>0$. Write $\mathbf G_{m,Z}$ for the sheaf of units on the small etale site of $Z$ [def-sc-gm-torsor], and $\underline{\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z}_Z$ for the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the constant presheaf. Given global units $\zeta\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)^\times$ and $\eta\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)^\times$ with $\zeta^n=\eta^n=1$ and $g^*\zeta=\eta$, let $m_\zeta$ and $m_\eta$ be the sheafified maps sending a natural-number class $a$ to the restriction of $\zeta^a$ and $\eta^a$, as in the precursor to [def-sc-mu-trivialization]. Let $c_g:g^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,Y}\to\mathbf G_{m,X}$ be the adjoint of pullback of units and $\alpha_g:g^{-1}\underline{\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z}_Y\simeq\underline{\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z}_X$ the canonical constant-sheaf comparison from uniqueness of left adjoints [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Then $g^{-1}(m_\zeta)\mathbin{;}c_g=\alpha_g\mathbin{;}m_\eta$. No primitivity, field, or nonemptiness hypothesis is required.

source.place: proof, proper case: compatible primitive-root trivializations

proof.text: Use the adjunction obtained by composing constant-sheaf/global-sections on Y with inverse-image/direct-image, and transporting its right adjoint by the terminal-sections comparison. Its left-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism is exactly alpha_g. Apply its Hom equivalence to the desired equality. Hom-equivalence naturality and homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app turn the right side into the constant-sheaf/global-sections transpose of m_eta, and the left side into the transpose of m_zeta followed by pullback of units and the terminal-sections comparison.

The constant-sheaf adjunction is the composite of the constant-presheaf/evaluation and sheafification adjunctions. Its transpose of a map m is the terminal component of toSheafify followed by m. The defining sheafifyLift identities for m_zeta and m_eta therefore reduce the equality to the corresponding constant-presheaf maps evaluated on terminal objects.

Let T_Y and T_X be terminal small-etale objects, and q:T_X to g.Etale(T_Y) the inverse terminal comparison. Evaluate on an arbitrary ZMod class and write it as its natural-number representative a. The left side is q.left.appTop applied to pullback.fst.appTop applied to T_Y.hom.appTop(zeta)^a; the right is T_X.hom.appTop(eta)^a. Ring maps preserve powers. The pullback square and the equation q.left followed by pullback.snd equals T_X.hom give q.left followed by pullback.fst followed by T_Y.hom equals T_X.hom followed by g. Contravariant functoriality of global sections and g^*zeta=eta identify these expressions. Extensionality of homomorphisms, ULift, Additive and units completes the equality.

theorem constantZModToGmSheaf_pullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (ζ : Γ(Y, ⊤)ˣ) (hζ : ζ ^ n = 1)
    (η : Γ(X, ⊤)ˣ) (hη : η ^ n = 1)
    (h : Units.map g.appTop.hom.toMonoidHom ζ = η) :
    (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).map
        (Y.constantZModToGmSheaf n ζ hζ) ≫ upperStarGmSheafToGmSheaf g =
      ((upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).app
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))).hom ≫
      X.constantZModToGmSheaf n η hη
